comparison.objective: Remove a dryer lint pad into a bin, then slide the cleaned lint screen back into its slot; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Screen extraction, contaminant separation/disposal, and guided reinsertion versus mandrel alignment, controlled impact, careful withdrawal, and tiny-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Lint reaches bin and screen is reinserted; no specs or cleanliness/insertion thresholds provided. Candidate requires four fractures, no insert/shell damage, and recovery of every tang.
comparison.reason: Both include disposal and insertion-related manipulation, but lint removal plus screen reinsertion does not test bimanual impact fracture or retained-coil protection.
